tagline: Smart Disaster Monitoring & Emergency Response Platform
hero_badge: Live hazard data · India and worldwide
hero_sub: Live earthquake, cyclone, flood and wildfire alerts from USGS, GDACS and NASA, plus a free preparedness academy. Starts with India, works worldwide. Advisory only, not an official warning service.
platform_sub: Built to be useful in the first minutes of an emergency, and to teach people before one happens.
feat_map_sub: Earthquakes, cyclones, floods and wildfires on one map, colour-coded by severity, with a heat layer and filters.
feat_alert_sub: The most serious events in your region first, with source and time. Sound cue for new high-severity events.
feat_ops_sub: Live KPI dashboard with response time tracking, incident distribution, and resolution metrics.
feat_shelter_sub: Nearest hospitals, police, fire stations and shelters from OpenStreetMap, with call and directions links.
feat_academy_sub: Lessons, quizzes and a certificate for floods, fires, earthquakes, cyclones and road accidents.
feat_voice_sub: Ask safety questions by voice or text in English, Hindi or Tamil. Works with built-in guidance even when the AI service is unavailable.
dashboard_sub: Real events from public feeds. Refreshes every 5 minutes.
demo_mode: Demo mode — adds to local session
footer_desc: Smart Disaster Monitoring & Emergency Response Platform. Built for rapid crisis awareness, visual monitoring, and emergency coordination.
bot_welcome: Hi! I’m your Disaster Assistance AI. Ask me what to do during an emergency, or how to prepare.
bot_fallback: Voice isn’t supported in this browser. You can type instead.
bot_prompt_1: What should I do during a flood?
bot_prompt_2: How do I prepare an emergency kit?
login_sub: Sign in to access the emergency dashboard
calm_title: Pick an exercise or ask me to start one
hero_data_line: Data: USGS · GDACS (UN/EU) · NASA EONET · OpenStreetMap
india_quiet: No tracked hazards in India right now. Switch to World to see the rest of the planet.
offline_cached: showing saved data (offline or feeds down)
not_official: Advisory only. Follow official warnings (IMD, NDMA, local authorities).
no_alerts: Nothing serious to report in this region.
nearby_hint: Share your location to list the nearest hospitals, police, fire stations and shelters.
nearby_error: Could not reach the map service. Try again in a minute.
osm_credit: Data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Coverage varies by area.
triage_note: Status is your own checklist, saved on this device. Official sources do not see it.
unverified_note: Community report saved on this device only. Nobody has verified it. For real emergencies call your local number.
report_note: Saved on this device and shown as unverified. Not sent to any authority.
profile_sub: Optional. Your name appears on Academy certificates.
profile_privacy: No account, no password. Stored only in this browser.
footer_tag: Know what's happening. Know what to do.
feat_offline_sub: Install it on your phone. Emergency numbers, guidance and the last data you loaded stay available without internet.
